title: Grateful Dead Live at Felt Forum, Madison Square Garden on 1971-12-05

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of an inspired East‑Coast 1971 show with a smoking Dark Star > Me & My Uncle > Dark Star > Sitting On Top Of The World sequence, though the mix has odd stereo imaging that could use mastering.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for its energetic, old‑school Dead swagger and especially the expansive Dark Star/Me & My Uncle jam, with both Weir and Phil delivering smoky vocals. The soundboard source is generally clear but suffers from weird stereo imaging and rough spots in the mix that would benefit from professional mastering.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave high marks (4‑5 stars) and highlighted a strong show with standout jams; recording issues are noted but not severe enough to outweigh the musical quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mix is decent overall but has problematic stereo imaging and rough spots that could be improved with mastering; no major dropouts reported.

standout_songs: Dark Star > Me & My Uncle > Dark Star > Sitting On Top Of The World
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows well with a strong, jam‑heavy second half; the band seems to be enjoying themselves and delivering classic Dead swagger.

band_member_comments.Phil: Pig (Phil) noted for smoky vocals and solid performance during the jam sections.
band_member_comments.Bob: Weir’s vocals and guitar work described as "smokin" on the NFA segment.
